summary: Retain each refused admission attempt's bounded error before scratch cleanup and report its detail on the matching harness diagnostic and failed restart.

replay.detail: No replay or claim-fold changes; existing diagnostic and restart reason fields carry the detail.

schema.detail: No database, claim, or measured-admission cache schema changes. The local driver-diagnostic record gains an optional attempt object tolerated by older readers.

rules.detail: Admission timers, cache ordering, overrides, replication, retention and coordination rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Old local readers ignore the optional field. New graph publishers require an attempt matching the current runtime, so unfenced legacy diagnostics supply no new attempt error. Upgrade the driver and runtime owner for detailed reasons. The normal source-based probe identity changes with the implementation and causes a fresh measurement at the next applicable launch.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond normal binary deployment; running providers are unaffected.

manual.detail: No manual action, cache edit or admission override is required.

recovery.detail: Revert the binary to restore the earlier diagnostics; existing store and cache records remain readable.
